head: WORKTREE
summary: Minimal, in-scope change: line 0.30 to 0.90, new branch 0.75 limit via a property, ADR 0003 updated with ratchet rule and history. Exclusions untouched. Headroom is about 6 points on line and 8 on branch. Build passes 115/115.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: pom.xml:36-37 properties and the BRANCH COVEREDRATIO limit at pom.xml:~221-225 in the shared rule; measured 96.5% line and 83.3% branch for ledger-service, 100% for architecture-rules.
pom.xml excludes diff is empty; only *Application and the generated OpenAPI api/model packages remain excluded.
Build pass log maven-20261013-170928.log; orchestrator negative check in a throwaway worktree failed on branch 0.45<0.75 and line 0.79<0.90 (reported, not committed).
docs/adr/0003-testing-strategy.md: ratchet rule bullet, property locations, and Threshold history table with dated rows.

findings.description: The ADR says thresholds apply per module and excludes only bootstrap and generated code; accurate, but the 2026-10-12 history row date is inferred and not verifiable from the diff.
findings.suggestion: Confirm the date against git log if it matters.
